exact: List.Sort selected thunk, range/array preparation, canonical ArraySortHelper.Sort, default cache/factory schedules, first comparable factory branch definition usage, canonical GenericComparer.Compare and interface helper argument carriers.

FSMTransition generic declaration implements IComparable<FSMTransition<T>> at its declared CompareTo slot; selected canonical priority CompareTo pointer differs from all interface-helper inline cases.
conditional: Null comparer and valid count/range conditions reach default getter. Runtime context/type conversions, static cache reads, class initializers and factory outcomes are explicit inputs with normal Win64 returns.

The comparable factory branch requires the observed assignability predicate true and valid converted runtime types. Actual allocated comparer identity and interface-table target require runtime evidence.

Only a resolved interface function pointer equal to the previously proved canonical transition CompareTo pointer selects that body; method context, receiver type and lifetime are not inferred from source identity.
unresolved: Actual default comparer instance/type selection, initialized runtime context, runtime generic factory effects, other factory branches, sorting algorithm/order/tie stability, object lifetime and capture execution.
